says: In a cloud box shared by several agents, pnpm lint runs its 18 parts at once, and the parts that start a TypeScript API process (lint:promise-types, lint:kind, lint:dead) fail with EPIPE or an unexpected EOF when the box's memory cgroup kills a compiler, though each passes alone.
proof: Two full pnpm lint runs with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 on fabrikalfa/effect-e99 failed in those parts with 'Error: EPIPE: broken pipe, write' and 'Unexpected EOF while reading from child process'; dmesg showed 'Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process (tsc)' while another agent ran tsgo, code-graph and oxlint; each part run alone passed. Other slices (E93, E87, E82) saw the same.
cost: Every step in a shared box sees a red lint that is not its own, and reruns parts by hand or reports a false red.
